approvedRule: Mapped authorized tool, identified app user, or named GitHub actor from source. Never guessed from IP.
unidentifiedRule: Real event without reliable identity → לא מזוהה. Successful unmapped access → דורש בדיקה. Never attacker/unauthorized/external without proof.
activePeopleRule: App heartbeats only (security_activity_sessions). GitHub/VPS/Supabase events are not counted as פעילים עכשיו.
changed: Display classification: מאושר / מוכר, לא מזוהה, דורש בדיקה, נחסם / נכשל
